sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 178.2 x 140.3 x 54.3 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Zoom F8n Pro operation manual and product page (opened by a research pass 2026-11-12): eight locking XLR / TRS combo inputs (1-4 on the left panel, 5-8 on the right), a 10-pin capsule input, two TA3 main outputs, a stereo 3.5 mm sub output and a headphone jack (right panel), BNC timecode in and out, a mini-B USB port (left), two SD slots, 12 V DC in (AD-19), a Hirose 4-pin external DC input and eight AA batteries. Modelled subset: two combo inputs, USB, the sub output and the headphone jack; the TA3 outputs (no catalogue connector), BNC timecode, DC inputs and SD slots are not ports. No mains inlet (battery or DC), so no power control. 178.2 x 140.3 x 54.3 mm (datasheet, size ok). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
